question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The humble surroundings of our company ______ creativity amongst the newly recruited employees.
solution:
The correct answer is '**inspired**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "inspired" is the most appropriate here, as it means to encourage or stimulate creativity, which fits the context of fostering creativity in employees.
 
• "Banished" means to force something or someone out, which does not fit the context of encouraging creativity.
 
• "Connected" refers to forming a link or relationship, which does not specifically convey the idea of fostering creativity in this context.
 
• "Fled" means to run away or escape, which is unrelated to the idea of encouraging creativity in a workplace setting.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *"The humble surroundings of our company inspired__ creativity amongst the newly recruited employees."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Banished (निकालना)**: means to expel or send away, which does not fit in the context of fostering creativity.
 
• **Connected (जोड़ना)**: while it may imply forming relationships, it does not directly refer to stimulating creativity.
 
• **Fled (भागना)**: means to run away, which is completely unrelated to the context of encouraging creativity in the workplace.
